original_query: What are two advantages to Genome wide Association?

summaries.summary: The image presents a table comparing advantages and drawbacks of two methods for identifying the genetic basis of complex traits: Candidate gene association mapping (2002) and Genome wide Association (2005). Under the Genome wide Association section, two advantages are listed: fine mapping (blind approach) and detection of common alleles.
key_facts: Genome wide Association (2005) has advantages including fine mapping (blind approach) and detection of common alleles.
The table also includes drawbacks for both methods, such as requiring detailed knowledge for candidate gene mapping and reduced power to detect rare alleles for Genome wide Association.
visible_text: Advantages and drawbacks of methods for identifying the genetic basis of complex traits
